title: Video Editor
description:
Role & responsibilities Create engaging, learner-friendly training videos for RCM Gurukul Aarohan by converting scripts, voiceovers, presentations, and raw footage into clear and professional video content. The ideal candidate should think from a learner's perspective, visually simplify complex information, and collaborate closely with trainers, content teams, and subject matter experts. Key Result Areas: Edit training, explainer, and presenter-led videos. Convert scripts and learning concepts into effective visual sequences. Use on-screen text, graphics, icons, animations and motion graphics to simplify concepts. Synchronise voiceover, visuals, music and sound effects. Maintain consistency with RCM/Aarohan branding. Work accurately with Hindi/Devanagari and English text. Create subtitles/captions and multilingual versions when required. Incorporate feedback and manage revisions efficiently. Maintain organised project files, source files, and reusable video assets. Ensure final videos meet required quality and technical standards. 
 Skills required: Strong video editing and visual storytelling skills. Good understanding of pacing and learner engagement. Ability to visualise educational content, not just edit footage. Working knowledge of motion graphics and basic animation. Good typography and layout sense. Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines. 
 Educational /Professional Qualification: Graduate/Diploma/Certification in Video Editing, Multimedia, Animation, Media Production, or related field preferred. Software Proficiency: Essential: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop/Illustrator or equivalent tools.
 Good to have: Audio editing tools, Canva, and AI-assisted video/content tools. 
 Work Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant experience preferred. Experience in training, e-learning, explainer, or Hindi/regional-language videos will be an advantage. 
 Competencies Required: Quality and clarity of videos Learner engagement Accuracy of content Visualisation of learning concepts Adherence to branding Turnaround time Responsiveness to feedback File and asset management

Key Skills: Video Editing,Visual Effects,Video Production,Adobe Premiere Pro,Motion Graphics,Animation,Video,Motion
